title: OpenArc Testnet reference delivery receipt
description: Provider assertion for one deterministic reference sum delivery. This is NOT chain settlement, a quality proof, user authorization, a signature, or retrieval success. It embeds no raw input or output. Property names use the lowercase snake_case identifier grammar required by the listing evidence contract; no camelCase alias mapping exists.

delivery_id.description: Opaque lowercase UUIDv4 delivery identifier; not a capability or token.

listing_version.description: Canonical immutable listing version from 1 to 999999999.

input_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical request input bytes.

output_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical response output bytes.

delivered_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of first delivery, at most microsecond precision, with an explicit Z offset.
